title: Slovakian Vegetable Dumplings
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired vegetarian dish featuring tangy and dense vegetable dumplings.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and warm water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the cabbage and carrots to the pan and cook until softened.
Add the paprika, salt, and pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Place a tablespoon of the cabbage and carrot mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-circle shape and press the edges together to seal.
Heat a large pot of salted water over high heat.
Carefully add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Serve the dumplings hot with the cabbage and carrot mixture spooned over the top.
